title: Frontiers: Unmasking Social Compliance Behavior During the Pandemic
authors: Shunyuan Zhang; Kaiquan S. J. Xu; Kannan Srinivasan
eligible_reason: Not staggered. Transaction-level panel of loyalty-program customers at one store; Tables 2-4 run xtreg y b2.customer_groupInd##Covid + store-crowdedness controls + hour, weekend and day-of-week dummies, fe (customer FE). Covid = 1 from a single common date (2020-01-22, verified in data: pre 2020-01-01 to 01-21, post 01-22 to 05-31); the group is a three-valued mask-wearing category (fully, partially, unmasked). One onset date, multi-valued group, time-varying controls, no calendar-time FE.
design_notes: Stata mask_analysis.do, single file; mask_data.dta (3,479 transactions). Outcomes: distance to cashier, time per item, store visits (Table 2); quantity, price, discount, popularity (Table 3); basket diversity (Table 4). Robust SE.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: single common post date (Covid onset); three-valued group x Covid; time-varying crowdedness controls; no calendar-time FE

data_files_note: Panel used in the manuscript; some variables pre-logged.
data_provenance_note: README describes it as the panel used in the manuscript.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex metadata (no article text). Common-timing pre/post pandemic comparison across mask groups.
